name: apple-platform-performance
description: Effective Apple Platform Performance — numbered Do/Don't items with code snippets for SwiftUI and UIKit, grounded in Apple's five canonical performance docs (SwiftUI performance, hangs, hitches, diagnosing early, launch time). Covers view-body cost, dependency tracking, hangs (main-thread blocks), hitches (dropped frames), launch-time budget, image decoding, off-screen rendering, and XCTest perf metrics for CI gating.
